## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/long-text-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Required.** Usually off: an open comment is better skipped than filled to move on.

## Best practices for research

Ask 1 specific thing, such as what to change, rather than for any comments: specific prompts give answers you can code.

Reference: Krosnick, J. A., & Presser, S. (2010). Question and questionnaire design. In P. V. Marsden & J. D. Wright (Eds.), *Handbook of survey research* (2nd ed., pp. 263-313). Emerald.
